inputs.rule_text: fit of cost-20261025T060213Z at 1, 4 and 16 tables (coefficient gc_round_requests_steady): a fold after the first reads GET 19 + 1 per new manifest + 1 per tail record + 12 per table, PUT 5, LIST 4 (5 from the fourth fold), DELETE 0 (2 from the fourth fold); the first fold of a process reads GET 13 + 8 per table with its new records only; a Deferred round GET 12, PUT 1, LIST 3; each manual round adds one heartbeat pulse (GET 1, PUT 1). The card rule carries the per-table term in the fold base for this N; the first fold and the gen pruning give the residuals below
inputs.listing_rule: per table one catalog GET and one LIST of _files/ every 305 s: 2 per table in 12 minutes
inputs.insert_rule: fresh Compact part: HEAD 1, PUT 9, GET 7 per insert, plus 1 GET per table life

GetObject.reason: inserts plus 0-3 cleanup listings per table outside the rounds

ListObjectsV2.reason: cleanup listings outside the rounds; one inside a round is maintenance

source_refs.claim: SYSTEM CAS GC RUN runs one synchronous round
a round with no changed shard and no due graduation is Deferred: no fold
each ref transaction appends one immutable _log object (create-only PUT)
a round that acquires the lease pulses once more
one pulse is a GET of gc/hb and one conditional PUT
a _snap snapshot is published after more than 256 log records or 1 MiB of tail
idle cleanup runs sleep max_cleanup_delay_period plus up to cleanup_delay_period_random_add
it iterates the table directory: on CAS a catalog GET and a LIST of the namespace files
